title: Bank of Punjab First Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Bank of Punjab First Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BANK OF PUNJAB
BANK OF PUNJAB
(FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE I OF 2003
An Ordinance further
to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 6th January, 2003]
No.Legis.13-4/2001, dated
6-1-2003.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Bank of Punjab (First
Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment in section 10 of
